builds.target: Portable Linux AArch64 · native N64 static recompilation
builds.notes: GitHub-published Linux ARM64 artifact: Zelda64Recompiled-v1.2.2-Linux-ARM64.zip. Native N64 static recompilation of The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask (not Ocarina of Time). Requires the correct personally dumped original game ROM; no Nintendo game assets included. Vulkan 1.2 runtime expected; Steam Frame untested.
